easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counter(s) due to Bioengineered Future.
When Scurry Oak enters, it triggers, creating a creature token that enters with +1/+1 counter(s) due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters with +1/+1 counter(s) due to Bioengineered Future.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.
